manualTranslations.zh: 皝記室參軍封裕諫曰：臣聞聖王之宰國也，薄賦而藏于百姓，分之以三等之田，十一而稅之；
manualTranslations.literal: Murong Huang's secretary-advisor Feng Yu remonstrated, saying: Your servant has heard that when a sage king governs a state, he keeps taxes light and stores wealth among the people, divides land into three grades, and levies one part in ten;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Murong Huang's secretary Feng Yu remonstrated: "I have heard that a sage king keeps taxes light and stores wealth among the people, divides land into three grades, and levies one part in ten;

manualTranslations.zh: 寒者衣之，饑者食之，使家給人足。
manualTranslations.literal: He clothes the cold and feeds the hungry, so that every household is provided for and every person has enough.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he clothes the cold and feeds the hungry until every household is provided for.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖水旱而不為災者，何也？
manualTranslations.literal: Though there be flood or drought, why is it not disaster?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Why then are flood and drought not disaster?

manualTranslations.zh: 高選農官，務盡勸課，人治周田百畝，亦不假牛力；
manualTranslations.literal: Select agricultural officers with care, strive to the utmost in encouragement and assessment; each man tends a full hundred mu of field and does not borrow ox power;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because high agricultural officers are chosen and encouragement enforced, each man tends a full hundred mu without borrowing oxen;

manualTranslations.zh: 力田者受旌顯之賞，惰農者有不齒之罰。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who labor in the fields receive banners of distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of being unranked.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: those who labor receive honors and the idle are punished.

manualTranslations.zh: 又量事置官，量官置人，使官必稱須，人不虛位，度歲入多少，裁而祿之。
manualTranslations.literal: Again measure affairs to establish offices, measure offices to appoint men, so that offices match need and men do not hold empty posts; estimate yearly revenue and trim salaries accordingly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Offices are matched to need, men do not hold empty posts, and salaries are trimmed to yearly revenue.

manualTranslations.zh: 供百僚之外，藏之太倉，三年之耕，餘一年之粟。
manualTranslations.literal: Beyond supplying the hundred officials, store in the Great Granary; three years' plowing leaves one year's grain surplus.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Beyond supplying officials, grain is stored in the Great Granary until three years' plowing leaves one year's surplus.

manualTranslations.zh: 以斯而積，公用于何不足？
manualTranslations.literal: Accumulated thus, how could public use be insufficient?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Stored thus, how could public use fail?

manualTranslations.zh: 水旱其如百姓何！
manualTranslations.literal: Flood and drought, what can they do to the people!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Flood and drought, what can they do to the people!

manualTranslations.zh: 雖務農之令屢發，二千石令長莫有志勤在公、銳盡地利者。
manualTranslations.literal: Though orders to promote agriculture are repeatedly issued, among the two-thousand-bushel administrators and magistrates none are intent on public diligence or keen to exhaust the land's advantage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet though farming orders issue repeatedly, no magistrate or two-thousand-bushel official works the land with public zeal.

manualTranslations.zh: 故漢祖知其如此，以墾田不實，征殺二千石以十數，是以明、章之際，號次升平。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore Han's founder, knowing this, executed more than ten such officials for false reports of reclaimed fields, and in the Ming and Zhang era the age was called nearly peaceful.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Knowing this, Han's founder executed more than ten such officials for false land reports, and under Ming and Zhang the age was nearly peaceful.

manualTranslations.zh: 自永嘉喪亂，百姓流亡，中原蕭條，千里無煙，饑寒流隕，相繼溝壑。
manualTranslations.literal: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate, for a thousand li no smoke rises; hunger and cold flow in ruin and men fall one after another into ditches and gullies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate and hunger fills the ditches.

manualTranslations.zh: 先王以神武聖略，保全一方，威以殄奸，德以懷遠，故九州之人，塞表殊類，繈負萬里，若赤子之歸慈父，流人之多舊土十倍有餘，人殷地狹，故無田者十有四焉。
manualTranslations.literal: The former king, by divine martial sage strategy, preserved one region; by might he destroyed traitors and by virtue he won the distant; therefore people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li, like infants returning to a loving father; the displaced exceeded the old population more than tenfold, the people were many and the land narrow, so those without fields were fourteen in ten.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and fourteen in ten had no fields.

manualTranslations.zh: 殿下以英聖之資，克廣先業，南摧強趙，東滅句麗，開境三千，戶增十萬，繼武闡廣之功，有高西伯。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, continuing the martial achievement of Murong Wu and Murong Guang, rivaling the great Earl of the West.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Highness, with heroic endowment, has extended the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li and added a hundred thousand households, rivaling the great Earl of the West.

manualTranslations.zh: 宜省罷諸苑，以業流人。
manualTranslations.literal: It is fitting to reduce and abolish the parks and estates and settle the displaced on them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Reduce the royal parks and settle refugees on the land.

manualTranslations.zh: 人至而無資產者，賜之以牧牛。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who arrive without property should be granted cattle to herd.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grant cattle to those who arrive without property.

manualTranslations.zh: 人既殿下之人，牛豈失乎！
manualTranslations.literal: If the people are Your Highness's people, how could the cattle be lost!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If the people are yours, how could the cattle be lost!

manualTranslations.zh: 善藏者藏于百姓，若斯而已矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Those who store well store among the people; that is all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: True storage is storage among the people; that is all.

manualTranslations.zh: 邇者深副樂土之望，中國之人皆將壺餐奉迎，石季龍誰與居乎！
manualTranslations.literal: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you; with Shi Hu, who can compare!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: You have fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will welcome you with food. Who can compare with Shi Hu!

manualTranslations.zh: 且魏、晉雖道消之世，猶削百姓不至於七八，持官牛田者官得六分，百姓得四分，私牛而官田者與官中分，百姓安之，人皆悅樂。
manualTranslations.literal: Even Wei and Jin, though an age of fading Way, still did not reduce the people below seven or eight tenths; those who farmed with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people; those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state; the people were secure and all rejoiced.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Even Wei and Jin, though the Way faded, did not reduce the people below seven or eight tenths; official-ox farmers gave six parts to the state and four to the people, private-ox farmers split evenly, and all rejoiced.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣猶曰非明王之道，而況增乎！
manualTranslations.literal: Your servant still says this is not the way of a clear king, and how much more if it is increased!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I still say this is not the way of a clear king, and how much more if burdens increase!

manualTranslations.zh: 且水旱之厄，堯、湯所不免，王者宜浚治溝澮，循鄭白、西門、史起溉灌之法，旱則決溝為雨，水則入於溝瀆，上無《雲漢》之憂，下無昏墊之患。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover flood and drought are misfortunes Yao and Tang did not escape; a king ought to dredge and maintain canals and ditches, follow the irrigation methods of Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; in drought open ditches as rain, in flood send water into channels; above no worry like the "Cloudy Han," below no trouble of mire and flood.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation like Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; drought is eased by channels and flood by drainage, ending worry above and mire below.

manualTranslations.zh: 句麗、百濟及宇文、段部之人，皆兵勢所徙，非如中國慕義而至，咸有思歸之心。
manualTranslations.literal: The people of Goguryeo, Baekje, and the Yuwen and Duan tribes were all moved by military force, not like those of China who came admiring righteousness; all have hearts that long to return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Goguryeo, Baekje, Yuwen, and Duan peoples were moved by force, not like Chinese who came admiring righteousness; all long to return home.

manualTranslations.zh: 今戶垂十萬，狹湊都城，恐方將為國家深害，宜分其兄弟宗屬，徙于西境諸城，撫之以恩，檢之以法，使不得散在居人，知國之虛實。
manualTranslations.literal: Now households approach a hundred thousand, crowded narrow against the capital; I fear this will soon become a deep harm to the state; it is fitting to divide their brothers and lineage and move them to western border cities, soothe them with kindness and inspect them with law, so they do not scatter among settled people and learn the state's strength and weakness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With households nearing a hundred thousand crowded against the capital, divide their kindred and move them to western border cities, ruling them with kindness and law so they do not learn the state's strength and weakness.

manualTranslations.zh: 今中原未平，資畜宜廣，官司猥多，遊食不少，一夫不耕，歲受其饑。
manualTranslations.literal: Now the central plain is not yet pacified and stores ought to be enlarged; official posts are numerous and idlers not few; one man who does not plow, the year receives his hunger.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The central plain is not pacified and stores must grow, yet offices multiply and idlers abound; one man who does not plow makes the year hungrier.

manualTranslations.zh: 必取於耕者而食之，一人食一人之力，游食數萬，損亦如之，安可以家給人足，治致升平！
manualTranslations.literal: Food must be taken from those who plow to feed others; one man eating the strength of one man, with tens of thousands idling, the loss is likewise; how can one achieve provision for every household and govern to peaceful ascendancy!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Food taken from plowmen feeds idlers; tens of thousands eat without plowing, and the loss is the same; how can every household be provided for and the realm governed to peace!

manualTranslations.zh: 殿下降覽古今之事多矣，政之巨患莫甚於斯。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Highness has read many affairs of past and present; no great evil of government exceeds this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Highness has read past and present; no governmental evil exceeds this.

manualTranslations.zh: 其有經略出世，才稱時求者，自可隨須置之列位。
manualTranslations.literal: Those with world-ranging strategy and talent suited to the age's needs may be placed in posts as needed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Men of world-ranging talent may be placed as needed.

manualTranslations.zh: 非此已往，其耕而食，蠶而衣，亦天之道也。
manualTranslations.literal: Beyond this, to plow and eat, to raise silkworms and clothe, is also heaven's way.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Beyond this, plow to eat and raise silkworms to clothe, as heaven ordains.

manualTranslations.zh: 殿下聖性寬明，思言若渴，故人盡芻蕘，有犯無隱。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for words as for water; therefore men exhaust even firewood and grass, offending yet not hiding.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Highness is broad and clear, thirsting for counsel; men speak even humble truths without hiding.

manualTranslations.zh: 前者參軍王憲、大夫劉明並竭忠獻款，以貢至言，雖頗有逆鱗，意在無責。
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly the staff officer Wang Xian and Grand Master Liu Ming both exhausted loyalty and offered sincerity, presenting utmost words; though they somewhat ruffled scales, the intent was not to blame.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Staff officer Wang Xian and Grand Master Liu Ming spoke with full loyalty; though they ruffled scales, they meant no offense.

manualTranslations.zh: 主者奏以妖言犯上，至之于法，殿下慈弘苞納，恕其大辟，猶削黜禁錮，不齒於朝。
manualTranslations.literal: The responsible officials memorialized that they spoke demonic words offending superiors and brought them to law; Your Highness, merciful and broad in acceptance, pardoned their capital offense yet still demoted, barred, and excluded them from court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Officials charged them with demonic speech; Your Highness pardoned their capital crime yet still barred them from court.

manualTranslations.zh: 其言是也，殿下固宜納之；
manualTranslations.literal: If their words were right, Your Highness ought indeed to accept them;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If their words were right, you ought to accept them;

manualTranslations.zh: 如其非也，宜亮其狂狷。
manualTranslations.literal: If not, you ought to make allowance for their blunt integrity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: if not, make allowance for blunt integrity.

manualTranslations.zh: 罪諫臣而求直言，亦猶北行詣越，豈有得邪！
manualTranslations.literal: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue; how can there be gain!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue!

manualTranslations.zh: 右長史宋該等阿媚苟容，輕劾諫士，己無骨鯁，嫉人有之，掩蔽耳目，不忠之甚。
manualTranslations.literal: Right Chief Clerk Song Gai and others flatter and accommodate, lightly impeach remonstrators, themselves without backbone yet jealous when others have it, covering eyes and ears, most disloyal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Right chief clerk Song Gai and others flatter, impeach remonstrators lightly, have no backbone yet envy it in others, and cover eyes and ears, most disloyal.

manualTranslations.zh: 四業者國之所資，教學者有國盛事。
manualTranslations.literal: The four occupations are what the state relies on; teaching and learning are the state's great affair.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The four occupations sustain the state; teaching and learning are its great affair.

manualTranslations.zh: 習戰務農，尤其本也。
manualTranslations.literal: Training for war and promoting agriculture are especially the root.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: War training and agriculture are especially the root.

manualTranslations.zh: 百工商賈，猶其末耳。
manualTranslations.literal: Merchants and craftsmen are yet the branch.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Merchants and craftsmen are the branch.

manualTranslations.zh: 宜量軍國所須，置其員數，已外歸之于農，教之戰法，學者三年無成，亦宜還之于農，不可徒充大員，以塞聰俊之路。
manualTranslations.literal: It is fitting to measure what army and state require, set the number of posts, and return the rest to farming; teach them battle methods; students who after three years have no achievement should also return to farming; they must not vainly fill great posts and block the path of the keen and worthy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Measure army and state needs, set posts, return the rest to farming, teach battle methods, and send students who fail after three years back to the fields; do not fill posts vainly and block worthy men.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣之所言當也，願時速施行；
manualTranslations.literal: If what your servant says is right, I wish it swiftly enacted;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If I am right, enact this swiftly;

manualTranslations.zh: 非也，登加罪戮，使天下知朝廷從善如流，罰惡不淹。
manualTranslations.literal: If not, add punishment and execution, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: if not, punish me, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.

manualTranslations.zh: 王憲、劉明，忠臣也，願宥忤鱗之愆，收其藥石之效。
manualTranslations.literal: Wang Xian and Liu Ming are loyal ministers; I wish their offense of ruffling scales pardoned and the effect of their medicine-stone counsel gathered.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Xian and Liu Ming are loyal ministers; pardon their bluntness and gather the benefit of their medicine-stone counsel."

sourceRange.text: 其尚書左承申紹上疏曰：臣聞漢宣有言：「與朕共治天下者，其唯良二千石乎！」是以特重此選，必妙盡英才，莫不拔自貢士，曆資內外，用能仁感猛獸，惠致群祥。今者守宰或擢自匹夫兵將之間，或因寵戚，藉緣時會，非但無聞於州閭，亦不經於朝廷。又無考績，黜陟幽明。貪惰為惡，無刑戮之懼；清勤奉法，無爵賞之勤。百姓窮弊，侵賕無已，兵士逋逃，乃相招為賊盜。風頹化替，莫相糾攝。且吏多則政煩，由來常患。今之見戶，不過漢之一大郡，而備置百官，加之新立軍號，兼重有過往時。虛假名位，廢棄農業，公私驅擾，人無聊生。宜並官省職，務勸農桑。秦、吳二虜僻僭一時，尚能任道捐情，肅諧偽部，況大燕累聖重光，君臨四海，而可美政或虧，取陵奸寇哉！鄰之有善，眾之所望，我之不修，彼之願也。秦、吳狡猾，地居形勝，非唯守境而已，乃有吞噬之心。中州豐實，戶兼二寇，弓馬之勁，秦、晉所憚，雲騎風馳，國之常也，而比赴敵後機，兵不速濟者何也？皆由賦法靡恆，役之非道。郡縣守宰每於差調之際，無不舍越殷強，首先貧弱，行留俱窘，資贍無所，人懷嗟怨，遂致奔亡，進闕供國之饒，退離蠶農之要。兵豈在多，貴於用命。宜嚴制軍科，務先饒復，習兵教戰，使偏伍有常，從戎之外，足營私業，父兄有陟岵之觀，子弟懷孔爾之顧，雖赴水火，何所不從！節儉約費，先王格謨；去華敦僕，哲後恆憲。故周公戒成王以嗇財為本，漢文以皁幃變俗，孝景宮人弗過千餘，魏武寵賜不盈十萬，薄葬不墳，儉以率下，所以割肌膚之惠，全百姓之力。謹案後宮四千有餘，僮侍廝養通兼十倍，日費之重，價盈萬金，綺縠羅紈，歲增常調，戎器弗營，奢玩是務。今帑藏虛竭，軍士無襜褕之齎，宰相侯王迭以侈麗相尚，風靡之化，積習成俗，臥新之諭，未足甚焉。宜罷浮華非要之設，峻明婚姻喪葬之條，禁絕奢靡浮煩之事，出傾宮之女，均商農之賦。公卿以下以四海為家，信賞必罰，綱維肅舉者，溫、猛之首可懸之白旗，秦、吳二主可以禮之歸命，豈唯不復侵寇而巳哉！陛下若不遠追漢宗弋綈之模，近崇先帝補衣之美，臣恐頹風弊俗亦革變靡途，中興之歌無以軫之絃詠。又拓宇兼併，不在一城之地；控制戎夷者，懷之以德。令魯陽、上郡重山之外，雲陰之北，四百有餘，而未可以羈服塞表，為平寇之基，徒孤危托落，令善附內駭。宜攝就並、豫，以臨二河，通接漕轂，擬之丘後；重晉陽之戍，增南籓之兵，戰守之備，炫以千金之餌，蓄力待時，可一舉而滅。如其虔劉送死，俟入境而斷之，可令匹馬不反。非唯絕二賊窺窬，乃是戡殄之要，惟陛下覽焉。

sourceRange.text: 襄尋徙北屈，將圖關中，進屯杏城，遣其從兄輔國姚蘭略地鄜城，使其兄益及將軍王欽盧招集北地戎夏，歸附者五萬餘戶。苻生遣其將苻飛拒戰，蘭敗，為飛所執。襄率眾西引，生又遣苻堅、鄧羌等要之。襄將戰，沙門智通固諫襄，宜厲兵收眾，更思後舉。襄曰：「二雄不俱立，冀天不棄德以濟黎元，吾計決矣。」會羌師來逼，襄怒，遂長驅而進，戰于三原。襄敗，為堅所殺，時年二十七，是歲晉升平元年也。苻生以公禮葬之。萇僭號，追諡魏武王，封襄孫延定為東城侯。

manualTranslations.zh: 襄尋徙北屈，將圖關中，進屯杏城，遣其從兄輔國姚蘭略地鄜城，使其兄益及將軍王欽盧招集北地戎夏，歸附者五萬餘戶。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiang soon moved to Beiqu, intending to take Guanzhong; he advanced and camped at Xingcheng, sent his cousin Yao Lan, aide to the state, to seize territory around Fucheng, and ordered his elder brother Yi and General Wang Qinlu to gather Rong and Xia of Beidi—more than fifty thousand households submitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiang soon shifted to Beiqu to seize Guanzhong, camped at Xingcheng, sent his cousin Yao Lan, aide to the state, against Fucheng, and had his brother Yi and General Wang Qinlu rally Beidi tribes—more than fifty thousand households came over.

manualTranslations.zh: 苻生遣其將苻飛拒戰，蘭敗，為飛所執。
manualTranslations.literal: Fu Sheng sent his general Fu Fei to resist; Lan was defeated and seized by Fei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fu Sheng sent Fu Fei to meet him; Lan lost and was captured.

manualTranslations.zh: 襄率眾西引，生又遣苻堅、鄧羌等要之。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiang led his host westward in retreat; Sheng again sent Fu Jian, Deng Qiang, and others to intercept him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiang drew his troops west; Sheng sent Fu Jian, Deng Qiang, and others to cut him off.

manualTranslations.zh: 襄將戰，沙門智通固諫襄，宜厲兵收眾，更思後舉。
manualTranslations.literal: About to give battle, Xiang was urgently remonstrated with by the monk Zhitong, who urged him to drill troops, gather his forces, and reconsider a later campaign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As Xiang prepared to fight, the monk Zhitong pressed him to drill his men, regroup, and wait for a better moment.

manualTranslations.zh: 襄曰：「二雄不俱立，冀天不棄德以濟黎元，吾計決矣。」
manualTranslations.literal: Xiang said: "Two heroes cannot stand together; I hope Heaven will not abandon virtue and forsake the black-haired people—my decision is made."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiang said, "Two heroes cannot stand together; I trust Heaven will not abandon virtue and leave the people unaided—my mind is made up."

manualTranslations.zh: 會羌師來逼，襄怒，遂長驅而進，戰于三原。
manualTranslations.literal: Just then the Qiang army pressed close; Xiang grew angry and charged straight ahead; they fought at Sanyuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the Qiang host closed in, Xiang flew into a rage, charged forward, and met them at Sanyuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 襄敗，為堅所殺，時年二十七，是歲晉升平元年也。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiang was defeated and killed by Jian; he was twenty-seven years old—it was the first year of Jin's Shengping reign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xiang was defeated and killed by Fu Jian at twenty-seven—in the first year of Jin's Shengping era.

manualTranslations.zh: 苻生以公禮葬之。
manualTranslations.literal: Fu Sheng buried him with ducal ceremony.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fu Sheng buried him with ducal honors.

manualTranslations.zh: 萇僭號，追諡魏武王，封襄孫延定為東城侯。
manualTranslations.literal: When Chang usurped the title, he posthumously enfeoffed Xiang as Wei Wuwang and made Xiang's grandson Yanding Marquis of Dongcheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Chang seized the throne, he posthumously titled Xiang Wei Wuwang and enfeoffed Xiang's grandson Yanding as marquis of Dongcheng.

sourceRange.text: 永康元年，詔征益州刺史趙廞為大長秋，以成都內史耿滕代廞。廞遂謀叛，潛有劉氏割據之志，乃傾倉廩，振施流人，以收眾心。特之党類皆巴西人，與廞同郡，率多勇壯，廞厚遇之，以為爪牙，故特等聚眾，專為寇盜，蜀人患之。滕密上表，以為流人剛剽而蜀人懦弱，客主不能相制，必為亂階，宜使移還其本。若致之險地，將恐秦雍之禍萃于梁益，必貽聖朝西顧之憂。廞聞而惡之。時益州文武千餘人已往迎滕，滕率眾入州，廞遣眾逆滕，戰于西門，滕敗，死之。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xin then plotted rebellion, secretly harboring the ambition to hold a Liu domain; he emptied the granaries, relieved the refugees, and sought to win their loyalty.

manualTranslations.zh: 特之党類皆巴西人，與廞同郡，率多勇壯，廞厚遇之，以為爪牙，故特等聚眾，專為寇盜，蜀人患之。
manualTranslations.literal: Li Te's followers were all men of Baxi, the same commandery as Xin, and mostly bold and strong; Xin treated them generously and used them as claws and teeth, so Te and his men gathered bands and devoted themselves to plunder, to the distress of the people of Shu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Te's followers were all men of Baxi, Xin's home commandery, and mostly bold warriors; Xin favored them as his strong arm, so Te and his men gathered bands and devoted themselves to plunder, to the distress of Shu.

manualTranslations.zh: 滕密上表，以為流人剛剽而蜀人懦弱，客主不能相制，必為亂階，宜使移還其本。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Teng secretly memorialized that the refugees were fierce while the Shu people were mild, that guest and host could not restrain each other and would surely bring disorder, and that the refugees should be sent back to their native places.

manualTranslations.zh: 廞聞而惡之。
